```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(grid)
library("RColorBrewer")
library(ggplot2)
library("ggpubr")
library(gridGraphics)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r }
data <-  read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Flica_Output/ABIDE/iterations1500/FSL_Format/150ica_secondfilter/Modality_contributions.txt', header=FALSE,sep=' ')


data_reordered <- data.frame(unlist(data)) #turn into table
vec_allIC <- unlist(lapply(1:150, function(x) rep(paste0("IC", sprintf("%02d", x)), 4)))

vec_modalities <- rep(c('JD', 'VBM', 'CT', 'PA'), 150)

data_reordered <- data.frame(
  contribution = unlist(data),
  contribution_percent = unlist(data) * 100,
  ICs = vec_allIC,
  Modalities = vec_modalities
)
#Builds the final tidy dataframe 

dim(data)       # 4 x 150
data[, 37] 

#give us modality contribution percentages
data_reordered %>%
  group_by(Modalities) %>%
  summarise(overall_percent = round(mean(contribution_percent), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(overall_percent))

data_reordered %>%
  group_by(ICs) %>%
  slice_max(contribution, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(Modalities)
```

# get multimodal matrix 
```{r}
data <- as.matrix(data)  # 4x150 matrix

x <- data 
multimodal <- 0 #initializes the vector

for(i in 1:150){
  N <- 4
  score <- max(x[,i]) - (1/N)
  mx <- 1 - (1/N)
  MAMI <- 1 - (score / mx)
  multimodal[i] <- MAMI
  print(MAMI)
}
print(multimodal)
#For each IC (i) take the maximum modality contribution, subtracts the expected value if all modalities contributed equally (1/4), then normalizes it. Result is 0 = one modality dominates completely, 1 = all modalities contribute equally.

# make multimodal df with MAMI score
legend_title='Modality'
IC_labels <- paste0("IC", sprintf("%02d", 1:150))
multimodal_df <- data.frame(ICs = IC_labels, Multimodal = multimodal)

# rep multimodal index across all ICs (for each 4 modalities per IC)
multimodal=data.frame(multimodal)
my_list <- list()
my_list

n=150*4
mat <- data.frame(ncol=1, nrow=n)
for (i in 1:150) {
  MM <- c(rep(multimodal[i,1],4))
  MM <- data.frame(MM)
  my_list[[i]] <- MM  
}
MM_rep <-do.call(rbind.data.frame, my_list)

# add multimodal index to data_reordered
data_reordered$MM_rep <- MM_rep$MM


# plot multimodal index modality contributions ordered across all ICs ORDERED
A <- ggplot(data = data_reordered, aes(x = reorder(ICs, MM_rep), y=contribution_percent, fill = Modalities)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = legend_title,
                  limits = c('JD', 'VBM', 'CT', 'PA'),
                  labels = c('JD', 'VBM', 'CT', 'SA')) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + coord_flip() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),        
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"              # was "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(y = "% contribution", x = "Independent components (sorted by multimodal index)")

B <- ggplot(data=multimodal_df, aes(x = reorder(ICs, Multimodal), fill= Multimodal)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "Multimodal index", low = "#FFFFFF", high = "#de2d26", limits = c(0,1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", '1'))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  geom_bar() + coord_flip()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
  )


library(patchwork)
final_plot_FSL <- (B + A) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 3.1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/ICsorted_FSL.jpg',
       plot = final_plot_FSL, width = 18.5, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 300)

```
